args.title: Fix issue 4410 in src/config.ts
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

The configuration function int() reads TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES using Number.parseInt, which only accepts integers. A value like '12h' is not an integer, so it is not rejected but fails to parse properly, likely defaulting incorrectly to 12. The code should validate and reject non-integer time strings to prevent misconfiguration and help users set the value correctly in minutes, e.g., using 720 for 12 hours.

args.title: Fix issue 4423 in src/i18n/index.ts
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

The function pickLocale parses the Accept-Language header but ignores the quality values (q= weights), returning the first supported language it finds. This causes a client preferring French by quality value to get English responses if English is listed first. Changing pickLocale to respect q= weights would fix this issue.
